Connect a visitor’s need with useful product information.

The corporate site introduces automatic and industrial door systems alongside the business. The traffic site serves a separate range of traffic lights, road-safety, LED and solar products. Each needs a structure that helps its audience find relevant information and an enquiry path.

Screenshots show the public homepages reviewed on 26 October 2026.

Website design and development, grounded in the business.

I designed and developed both websites. My contribution combines interface design, content structure and WordPress implementation to turn specialist product information into a usable public experience.

The public builds use established WordPress foundations, including theme and plugin components. My delivery claim is the design and development of these websites; it does not claim authorship of the underlying third-party products.

  • Website design
  • WordPress development
  • Content structure
  • Responsive layouts
  • Product navigation
  • Commercial delivery

A delivery count with a clear meaning.

What I delivered
Design and development of two commercial websites, confirmed by my account of the work.
What is visible
Live public pages, product areas and the current interface. Both websites can be explored directly.
What was reviewed
Homepages and visible product information on 26 October 2026. The review did not submit quote requests, orders or payments.
Outcome boundary
The two-site count measures delivered website examples. It does not establish conversion uplift, revenue growth or a before-and-after performance improvement.
Ongoing work
Delivery dates, current maintenance responsibility and commercial outcome measures remain separate facts to confirm.
